summary: Comprehensive testing of Food Allergy & Exclusion System. All 11 backend tests PASSED (100%). The system correctly: 1) Saves and retrieves user exclusions via POST/GET /api/exclusions, 2) Filters out shrimp/prawn and chicken recipes from Chat responses, 3) Filters excluded ingredients from Diabetes recipe responses, 4) Handles ingredient aliases (prawn blocked when shrimp excluded), 5) Returns safe proteins (lamb, mutton, beef, fish) when chicken/shrimp excluded, 6) Uses word boundary regex matching to avoid false positives (e.g., 'hen' in 'when', 'then', 'kitchen' not blocked). Frontend UI for exclusion selection during registration is working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: User registration returns valid token
Backend: POST /api/exclusions saves user exclusions (shrimp, chicken)
Backend: GET /api/exclusions retrieves saved exclusions correctly
Backend: POST /api/chat/send filters out shrimp/prawn recipes when excluded
Backend: POST /api/chat/send returns safe proteins (lamb, mutton, beef, fish)
Backend: Prawn (shrimp alias) correctly blocked when shrimp excluded
Backend: POST /api/diabetes/recipes filters out excluded ingredients
Backend: Diabetes recipes return safe proteins when chicken/shrimp excluded
Backend: Word boundary matching prevents false positives (no over-filtering)
Backend: Specific dish names (butter chicken, chicken tikka, prawn curry) correctly blocked
Frontend: Start Cooking button opens auth modal
Frontend: Sign Up form with name, email, password fields working
Frontend: Step 2 - Exclude Ingredients UI displays correctly
Frontend: Shrimp and Chicken exclusion buttons selectable
Frontend: Selected Exclusions section shows count and items
Frontend: Important notice about exclusions displayed
Frontend: Save & Continue button completes registration

context_for_next_testing_agent: Food Allergy & Exclusion System fully tested and working. Key findings: 1) Word boundary regex matching (r'\b' + term + r'(?:s|es)?\b') prevents false positives like 'hen' matching in 'when', 'then', 'kitchen'. 2) Ingredient aliases properly handled - prawn blocked when shrimp excluded. 3) Two-pass filtering: structured recipe filter then strict line-by-line filter. 4) Both Chat and Diabetes endpoints apply safety filtering. 5) Frontend exclusion UI during registration works correctly.
